name: GSA Sport
verdict: Sportswear brand of GEPAWORLD Group. Private owner, no state stake found, no human-rights finding against the company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: official jersey and sportswear partner of Anadolu Efes S.K. from the 2025-2026 season onward, kit maker of the 2026-27 jerseys. Owned via GEPAWORLD Group (gsa-sport-gepaworld-ownership); the club's announcement is the only source naming the parent, and no state stake is named anywhere in the chain.
